description: This file defines function prototypes for parsing and converting OVSDB-related data structures and messages to JSON format in the OvsDbApi component.

methods.name: ovsdb_insert_to_json
methods.description: Converts a table configuration to JSON with a unique ID

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor_to_json
methods.description: Converts monitor information of an OVS table to JSON

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor_cancel_to_json
methods.description: Creates JSON to cancel a monitor based on old ID

methods.name: ovsdb_delete_to_json
methods.description: Converts delete operation details to JSON

methods.name: ovsdb_parse_msg
methods.description: Parses an OVSDB JSON message into internal data structures
